hooks.command: set -euo pipefail; INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); [ -z "$CMD" ] && exit 0; FALLBACK_REGEX='\bDROP[[:space:]]+(TABLE|DATABASE|SCHEMA|INDEX)\b|\bTRUNCATE[[:space:]]+TABLE\b|rm[[:space:]]+-rf[[:space:]]|git[[:space:]]+reset[[:space:]]+--hard|git[[:space:]]+clean[[:space:]]+-[a-z]*f|git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]].*(--force\b|-f\b)'; FALLBACK_MARKER='CONFIRMED-DESTRUCTIVE'; source enforcement/config.env 2>/dev/null || true; REGEX="${DESTRUCTIVE_OP_REGEX:-$FALLBACK_REGEX}"; MARKER="${DESTRUCTIVE_OP_CONFIRM_MARKER:-$FALLBACK_MARKER}"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -Eq "$REGEX"; then if echo "$CMD" | grep -Fq "$MARKER"; then exit 0; fi; echo "BLOCKED: this command matches a destructive-operation pattern (DROP/TRUNCATE/unscoped DELETE/rm -rf/force-push/git reset --hard). Per anti-ai-slop-code.md's top-priority rule, get explicit human confirmation for this exact command, then re-run it with the literal text '$MARKER' included (e.g. as a trailing comment) if it's genuinely intended." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

INPUT=$(cat); if [ "$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active')" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ -f UI-DETAIL.html ] && git status --porcelain -- UI-DETAIL.md 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then case "$(uname -s)" in Darwin) open UI-DETAIL.html >/dev/null 2>&1 & ;; Linux) xdg-open UI-DETAIL.html >/dev/null 2>&1 & ;; *) : ;; esac; fi; enforcement/run-audit.sh || exit 2

FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true ;; *.py) black -q "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true ;; *.go) gofmt -w "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true ;; *.rs) rustfmt "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac; exit 0
